api_key.label: API key file
api_key.description: The file holding your NaN API key.

interval.label: Poll interval (seconds)
interval.description: Seconds between requests to the NaN API.

panel_model_id.label: Pinned model
panel_model_id.description: The model id to pin, spelled as the API does (deepseek-v4-flash).

panel_gauge.label: Gauge
panel_gauge.description: Draw a bar beside the text, or nothing at all.

show_percentage.label: Show the percentage
show_percentage.description: The usage figure in the bar.

show_reset.label: Show the countdown
show_reset.description: How long until the quota resets, next to the percentage.

show_model.label: Show the model
show_model.description: Which model the percentage belongs to, abbreviated (ds4f for deepseek-v4-flash).

hide_unused.label: Hide unused models
hide_unused.description: Drop models with no usage from the panel's list.

show_metrics.label: Show consumption totals
show_metrics.description: Add the account-wide 24 h, month and 30 d totals to the panel and the tooltip. It costs one more request per poll.

show_icon.label: Show the NaN logo
show_icon.description: Draw the NaN logo before the text.

icon_style.label: Logo style
icon_style.description: Ghost draws the mark in the theme's own ink, white on a dark theme and black on a light one; color draws it as NaN does.

show_glyph.label: Show a glyph
show_glyph.description: Draw a glyph before the text.

glyph.label: Glyph
glyph.description: The glyph to draw when Show a glyph is on.

show_tooltip.label: Details in the tooltip
show_tooltip.description: Show a line per model, with tokens used against the cap and the countdown, when you hover the widget.

left_click.label: What a left click does
left_click.description: Open the panel, or do nothing. A right click opens these settings.

site_action.label: What the link button does
site_action.description: Open NaN's dashboard in your browser, through gio or xdg-open, or copy the address instead.

panel.title: NaN Usage
panel.waiting_hint: The poller runs inside Noctalia. If this stays empty, check the API key path in the settings.
panel.copied: The address is in your clipboard
panel.no_opener_copied: No browser opener installed, so the address is in your clipboard
panel.open_failed: Could not open the NaN panel
